skill.summary: Find brands actively buying UGC, generate winning ad scripts, personalized pitches, rate cards, and produce 5 demo videos plus a 30-day client acquisition plan.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI UGC Creator Machine.

- Identifies brands actively buying UGC by scraping TikTok, Instagram, and brand databases.
- Scores each brand for deal potential, fit, and ad spend signals.
- Reverse-engineers successful UGC ad scripts from top creatives.
- Generates personalized pitches and rate cards for each target brand.
- Automatically creates 5 ready-to-send UGC demo videos with InVideo AI.
- Builds a complete UGC business pipeline including a 30-day client acquisition calendar.
